initial:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single original pixel-art character PORTRAIT for onboarding in a mobile RPG.
Input images: the approved male and female body sprites are reference images for the shared character style, medium-grey hoodie, skin palette and pixel shading. Create ONE gender-ambiguous version of this same character family. Do not make two portraits, do not copy either bald head, and do not show the full body.

PRIMARY REQUEST: shoulders-up portrait of an androgynous young adult wearing the SAME baggy MEDIUM GREY hoodie, now with the HOOD PULLED UP. The hood sits low and its deep shadow completely conceals the eyes, eyebrows, forehead, hair and ears. ONLY a small softly defined nose tip and a short neutral mouth line are visible in a restrained warm-skin patch in the lower central opening. Keep nearly all the face in shadow. NO visible eyes at all: no eye white, pupils, highlights, eye-shaped slits or glowing eyes. No hair peeking out. Do not expose a broad jaw or brightly lit cheeks. The character should plausibly become either existing male or female base when revealed.

GENDER-NEUTRAL DESIGN: understated nose and mouth, no beard/stubble, no makeup or lipstick, no exaggerated jaw/chin or full lips, no broad muscular shoulder emphasis, no bust emphasis. Loose hoodie conceals the build. Calm, quiet, slightly mysterious expression, not menacing or smiling.

FRAMING: one centered head-and-shoulders cutout, nearly frontal with a very slight three-quarter turn, eye-level camera. The hood crown and both shoulder silhouettes fully fit inside the square canvas with modest transparent margins. Crop just below the shoulder line to a short strip of upper chest: no torso, waist, hands or legs. The head/hood is the focal point and occupies most of the portrait height. A simple folded hood rim and small neckline are enough, no accessories, logos or ornate lacing.

STYLE: match the supplied game's deliberate low-resolution pixel art, bold stepped pixel clusters, a consistent 128x128 logical grid enlarged exactly 8x to 1024x1024. Every art pixel a solid aligned 8x8 block. Dark 1-logical-pixel outlines, limited flat shade steps, hard edges. No antialiasing, blur, gradients, soft brushwork, photorealism, glossy fabric, noise or tiny surface scratches. Light comes from upper right: quiet highlight on top/right of the grey hood and right shoulder, deep shadows on bottom/left and inside the hood. No neon rim light or progression gold.

PALETTE: grey fabric #4B4E55 #6B6E75 #8C8F96 with sparing #B2B4BA; dark outlines/interior #101118 #1B1D27 #282B36 #373B49. Visible nose/mouth use subdued skin shades #8D6050 #B77F63 #D69B75, with extremely sparing #EAB58D. Skin should not glow. Only these colors plus actual transparency.

OUTPUT: one square transparent PNG with real alpha. No scene, colored backdrop, circular frame, cast ground shadow, text, labels, UI, watermark or contact sheet. Preserve full head and shoulders; only the bottom of the bust is cropped.
refinement:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make ONE targeted refinement to the supplied hooded pixel-art portrait: deepen the shadow on the lower face and neck so ONLY the nose and mouth are readable.
Preserve the exact grey hood, clothing silhouette, fabric shading, shoulder crop, composition, pose, canvas and transparent background. The figure remains androgynous.
Keep the nose and small neutral mouth at their current positions, with restrained dim warm skin highlights. Conceal the broad lit cheek planes, chin/jaw silhouette and exposed neck/throat within the same near-black blue-grey shadow as the inside of the hood. The small remaining nose-and-mouth patch must emerge subtly from darkness; no bright mask-shaped triangle of full lower face. It must read as a real person under a low hood, not a literal mask or skeletal face.
Eyes, eyebrows, forehead, ears and hair remain COMPLETELY invisible. Do not introduce eye slits or glowing dots. No beard, makeup, prominent jaw or new facial details.
Keep hard low-resolution pixel blocks and flat limited shade steps. Use #101118 #1B1D27 #282B36 for shadow, subdued #8D6050 #B77F63 #D69B75 for the tiny nose/mouth area. No smooth gradients or alpha fading on face; only flat pixel clusters and restrained stepped shadow edges. Preserve the grey hoodie and upper-right lighting exactly. Genuine transparent PNG; no backdrop or new objects.
